video_title: Gilbert Arenas on the MENTALITY shift it took to become "HIBACHI" and his BLACK BOOK 👀

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his transition to becoming a go-to scorer
quotes.excerpt: I need to tap in. I got this rush.
quotes.quote: We just finished making it to the playoffs. Got the success. You know how you feel it's your moment, hitting the game winner. It's like, yo, what do you do now? So I was like, nah, man, I need to tap in. I got this rush. So DC had hoopers. So I'll go play at the Barry Farm. I'm tapping into the Barry Farm. They had the legends out there, so I'm hearing about them, and then people showing me tape on them, and I'm like, dude, kind of crafty.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on studying the skill sets of specific NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I'm watching their skill set and I'm like, yo, Kirk Hinrich, little guard, not athletic, craft.
quotes.quote: They had a dude out there by the name of the Wizard, they had Kirk Hinrich, they had White Chocolate. So I'm watching their skill set and I'm like, yo, Kirk Hinrich, little guard, not athletic, craft. He's like Brunson style, crafty, know how to bump. So I'm watching them, like get his shot off. Like, damn, how the little motherfucker get the shot off? It's kind of like that Earl Boykins. And I'm just watching them do stuff with the ball.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on learning the hesi move from Steve Francis
quotes.excerpt: DC had the hesi. That hesi shit, that came from that, you know, Steve Francis had it.
quotes.quote: DC had the hesi. That hesi shit, that came from that, you know, Steve Francis had it. So all of them, all of them had that, that, that bucket in it. So I just said, I just need a little bit of it so when I come, I can just go. They're teaching me how, they're watching my speed. So they see my thing was the in and out. So my move was, out, in and out, like depending on who you are.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on building his personal book of basketball moves
quotes.excerpt: Every time I seen some shit that I like, I wrote it down.
quotes.quote: Every time I seen some shit that I like, I wrote it down. I was like, oh shit, okay, this a rondo. And the rondo is you're coming left, and you see them coming, and hit them with that ball fake. Have them jump, boom. So I got that, boom. Jamal Crawford coming down with the ball on the inside, behind the back, snap it back. So I'm just writing all these moves. Anytime I seen something, I write it down, and then in the summer, I got this big ass book full of moves.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on working out with Will Bynum to master moves
quotes.excerpt: Will Bynum was like, hey man, I heard about the book. Let's go, what we got?
quotes.quote: If you ask Will Bynum, Will Bynum was like, hey man, I heard about the book. Let's go, what we got? So like he was sitting with me when I got to Chicago, he sit with me, and we just going through, just going through moves. Because I had to, I call it the Will Bynum where you throw it, pop, and we just working. I'm just like, show me how to do it. Like, all right, boom, boom.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his focus on step-back moves in practice
quotes.excerpt: I'm only doing fucking step-backs. I'm busting your ass doing step-backs.
quotes.quote: I'm only doing fucking step-backs. I'm busting your ass doing step-backs. So now, he knows I'm doing the move. Now, I got to try to get it off on him. Now I got to see how he's playing me. Like, all right, he's jumping, okay. So if I pump back, I can see that leg, I can just go. Okay, I got it. I can pump fake and get him leaning. So then I'm just working my moves like that.
